description: TV owner-profile module. Rust owns owner account, sudo posture, shell, and TV operator groups are maintained; this sidecar carries constants only.

constants.meaning: owner account, sudo posture, shell, and TV operator groups are maintained

args:
missing=""; have="$(id -nG owner 2>/dev/null || true)"; for g in wheel video input render audio storage network uucp; do echo "$have" | tr " " "
" | grep -qx "$g" || missing="$missing${missing:+,}$g"; done; [ -z "$missing" ] || /usr/sbin/usermod -aG "$missing" owner
